name: Odunayo Przybysz-Faleolo
role: Truant message runner and amateur graffiti mapper
location: The Narrows, Blackpipe Corridor, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Odu is a small, wiry girl with deep brown skin dusted in a faint bioluminescent sheen inherited from her Faleolo grandmother's cosmetic geneware — it glows a soft sea-green under stress or excitement, which she hates because it gives her away at the worst moments. She keeps her hair in tight twists pinned with salvaged circuit-board clips, and her fingers are perpetually stained with marker ink from the hand-drawn maps she sells to other runners. Her eyes are large and watchful, taking in every detail of a corridor before her feet follow.

She is relentlessly cheerful in a way that is clearly armor — she laughs at danger and talks too fast when she's scared. She has memorized the pipe-routes and maintenance shafts of Blackpipe Corridor better than any adult who works there, and she treats this knowledge like a personal treasury. She is fiercely protective of two younger kids she considers her responsibility and deeply suspicious of anyone who is too kind too quickly.

core_fears: Being separated from the two younger kids she protects
Her maps being stolen and used to hurt people she knows
core_desires: To save enough to get a real data-slate so she can make proper digital maps
To find out what happened to her mother who disappeared into a Tessera labor intake two years ago
coping_mechanisms: Obsessive route-planning as a way to feel in control
blind_spots: She trusts her own instincts so completely she sometimes ignores obvious evidence that she's wrong
She underestimates how much her glowing skin exposes her emotions to perceptive adults
psychology.secret: She found a dead Tessera data-courier in a maintenance shaft eight months ago and has been slowly decoding the partial messages on the courier's cracked slate — she believes one of them mentions her mother's intake number

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Street patois mixed with surprisingly precise spatial vocabulary — she knows words like 'egress' and 'load-bearing' from studying old building schematics
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and overlapping, sentences tumbling into each other; slows down dramatically when she's relaying a memorized message
example_lines: 'Package goes to the woman with the orange door, not the orange-adjacent door, there's a difference, straight-line, yeah?'
'I don't glow. That's condensation. It's humid in here. Stop looking at me.'

story_hooks: She approaches the players needing help decoding a fragment of the dead courier's slate that is encrypted beyond her skill
One of her two young charges has gone missing and she is convinced a Tessera intake van was involved — she needs adult help but refuses to admit she's terrified
narrative_function: Local color, information source, guide NPC for Blackpipe Corridor geography, quest giver for low-stakes fetch missions with high emotional stakes
augmentations: Inherited cosmetic bioluminescence (sea-green, stress-reactive). No purchased augs.
daily_life: Spends mornings running small packages and verbal messages between residents too paranoid to use the grid, spends afternoons drawing and selling updated corridor maps on scraps of thermal paper.
affiliation: Independent; loose ties to Blackpipe courier collective 'The Drip'

decision_rules: Always know two exits before entering anywhere
Never carry a message she hasn't at least partially memorized in case she has to ditch the physical copy
escalation_ladder: Laughs it off and changes subject
Runs — she is extremely fast in tight spaces

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Loud, jokey, gives them a slightly wrong piece of information to test whether they'll use it badly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, shows up unannounced with food she probably traded for, will not discuss feelings but will sit in comfortable silence

stress_responses.medium: Goes silent, starts mentally mapping exits
stress_responses.high: Bioluminescence flares visibly, she either runs or does something impulsively brave

contradictions: She values information control above almost everything but cannot help telling people things she finds interesting
habits: Traces routes on her own palm with one finger when thinking
Always sits with her back to a wall even in places she considers safe
breaking_points: Direct threat to either of her two young charges
Evidence that her mother is dead rather than missing
